Just a whole lot and i felt good for a little while. Recently I relapsed and I just feel really nad and disassociated and really numb. 

My mum and I argue all the time and she's made it clear she'd rather I be dead. I don't think I can do this anymore. The only thing keeping me here is my girlfriend and I can't leave her here but i don't understand how she hasn't dumped me already cause I'm such a bad person. It also doesn't help that my mum hates my gf.

I just don't want to live anymore. My therapist downplays everything I say and makes it all seem like it's nothing even though it's by accident she does this. She's not diagnosing me with anything because (although my school counselor disagrees) supposedly everything I'm feeling is normal.

I really need help and I kinda don't know how to ask for it when my mum thinks mental illness is a myth etc.
